description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.
